searchText: There *should* be different pricing for different operational costs. Network, CPU, Storage are the initial 3 obvious ones, with perhaps storage being separated into transient and long term. You need everything to have a fee though or else you open up DOS type attack vectors. Something to be aware of for pos validators. Likely the same holds true for aws and other server providers (we have used aws for a while though and been fine but be careful). https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/822563437929824276/1013136920139800646/image_from_ios.jpg?width=834&height=846 > node provider weird terminology With the burstiness of CPU usage from Eth nodes, I can't see why a cloud provider wouldn't see them as free money when hosted on shared hardware
